test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: According to Census of India 2011, which of the following States/Union Territories are in correct descending order of literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala, Lakshadweep, Mizoram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala**:-

 
 
• Kerala has consistently been at the top of the literacy rate rankings in India for several decades.
 
• **It has the highest literacy rate in India at 94.0%. **
 
 
 
• **Lakshadweep**:-
 
 
• **It has a literacy rate of 91.85%.**
 
• Lakshadweep is a Union Territory of India with a small population of around 65,000 people.
 
 
 
• **Mizoram**:-
 
 
• It is a state in Northeast India with a predominantly Christian population.
 
• Mizoram has a literacy rate of 91.33%.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Goa has a literacy rate of 87.4%.
 
• Maharashtra has a literacy rate of 82.9%.
 
• Puducherry has a literacy rate of 86.55%.
 
• Uttarakhand has a literacy rate of 79.6%.
 
• Tamil Nadu has a literacy rate of 80.09%.
